sentences.en: The journey, as I recall it, was long and tedious.
sentences.zh: 我回忆起来，那趟旅程既漫长又乏味。

sentences.en: The assignment was very difficult, requiring hours of tedious work.
sentences.zh: 这个任务非常困难，需要数小时单调的工作。

sentences.en: Your eccentricities can make you either charming or tedious.
sentences.zh: 你的怪癖可能会让你变得迷人也可能会让人觉得乏味。
